[[Clothing/Legends|Attire]] traditional to the [[Quermian/Legends|Quermian]] [[Species/Legends|species]], the '''cannom collar''' was worn by multiple Quermians. Individuals who wore the collar included [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Yarael Poof/Legends|Yarael Poof]], the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Minister of Defense (Republic)|Minister of Defense]] [[Koa Delko]], and the [[Teacher/Legends|teacher]] [[Murk Lundi]].

==Description==
The cannom collar was a piece of traditional [[Clothing/Legends|attire]] worn by members of the [[Quermian/Legends|Quermian]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. It was triangular in shape and sat at the base of the wearer's neck. They could be [[Color/Legends|colored]] brown,<ref name="TPMVD" /> orange,<ref name="KotOR47" /> or blue. They could also have a gilded design.<ref name="CrimsonEmpire3EmpireLost1" />

==History==
[[Koa Delko]], the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Minister of Defense (Republic)|Minister of Defense]] during the [[Mandalorian Wars]], wore a cannom collar while confronting the [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] [[Demagol]] in [[3963 BBY]].<ref name="KotOR47" /> The [[Teacher/Legends|teacher]] and researcher of the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]], [[Murk Lundi]], wore a cannom collar<ref name="JediVSith">[[Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force (real-life book)|''Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force'']]</ref> at some point prior to his [[Death/Legends|death]]<ref name="JediApprentice">''[[Jedi Apprentice Special Edition: The Followers]]''</ref> in [[29 BBY/Legends|29 BBY]] as well.<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Yarael Poof/Legends|Yarael Poof]] wore a cannom collar at various points<ref name="TPMVD" /> between [[44 BBY/Legends|44]] to [[37 BBY/Legends|37 BBY]]<ref name="YaddleDate">"[[Yaddle's Tale: The One Below]]" takes place after [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon's]] ascension to the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]], which ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates to [[44 BBY/Legends|44 BBY]], and prior to [[Yaddle/Legends|Yaddle's]] ascension to the Council. Yaddle appears as a member of the Jedi High Council during [[Qui-Gon and Obi-Wan: Last Stand on Ord Mantell 1|''Qui-Gon and Obi-Wan: Last Stand on Ord Mantell'' 1]], established in its introduction to take place five [[Standard year/Legends|years]] prior to {{Film|I}}, which is dated by ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' to [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], five years after [[37 BBY/Legends|37 BBY]]. Therefore, this story must take place between 44 and 37 BBY.</ref> and his death<ref name="ZamWesell">''[[Star Wars: Zam Wesell]]''</ref> in [[27 BBY/Legends|27 BBY]]. That same [[Standard year/Legends|year]],<ref name="SWTCC">''[[Star Wars: The Comics Companion]]''</ref> during Poof's [[Funeral/Legends|funeral]], he was [[Cremation/Legends|cremated]] wearing a cannom collar while three Quermian<ref name="ZamWesell" /> [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] in attendance&mdash;[[Loo Raelo]], [[Vinian Ska]], and [[Kindee Ya]]<ref name="QuermianKnights">{{FactFile|100|POO 1-2|Yarael Poof}} states that [[Yarael Poof/Legends|Yarael Poof]] was one of only four [[Quermian/Legends|Quermians]] enlisted in the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. The other three Quermians in the Order are depicted&mdash;wearing cannom collars&mdash;in ''[[Star Wars: Zam Wesell]]'', albeit unidentified. ''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]'' identifies the three Quermian Jedi aside from Poof as the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] [[Loo Raelo]], [[Vinian Ska]], and [[Kindee Ya]], meaning the three must have been the Quermian Jedi depicted wearing cannom collars in ''Zam Wesell''.</ref>&mdash;wore them as well.<ref name="ZamWesell" /> In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="SWTCC" /> a Quermian [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] wore a cannom collar to a memorial for four dead Jedi Masters&mdash;[[Knol Ven'nari]], [[Jon Antilles]], [[Nico Diath]], and [[Fay]].<ref name="Repub53">[[Republic 53|''Republic'' 53]]</ref> A Quermian member of the [[New Republic Ruling Council]]<ref name="CrimsonEmpire3EmpireLost1" /> in [[13 ABY/Legends|13 ABY]]<ref name="Back in the Red">{{SWArchive|url=vault/books/crimsonempire3/index.html|text=Back in the Red: Dark Horse Comics Announces Long-Awaited Crimson Empire III Series}}</ref> wore a cannom collar.<ref name="CrimsonEmpire3EmpireLost1" />

==Behind the scenes==
The cannom collar's first appearance was in a storybook adaptation of ''The Phantom Menace'', [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace Movie Storybook|''Episode I: The Phantom Menace Movie Storybook'']],<ref name="Storybook">[[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace Movie Storybook|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace Movie Storybook'']]</ref> which was released in [[April]] [[1999]]<ref name="StorybookDate">{{RandomHouseOld|url=kids/catalog/display.pperl?isbn=0375800255|text=Star Wars Episode I: The Phantom Menace Movie Storybook}}</ref> and published by Random House.<ref name="Storybook" /> It was first shown in the teaser trailer for the<ref name="TPMTeaser">{{SW|url=video/episode-i-teaser-trailer|text=Episode I Teaser Trailer}}</ref> film [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']], the first installment of the ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[prequel trilogy]], which released on [[May 19]], 1999. The trailer debuted in theaters across twenty-six cities on [[November 17]], [[1998]],<ref name="SWYBY">''[[Star Wars Year By Year: A Visual History, New Edition]]''</ref> with a wider release on [[November 20]] the same year.<ref name="TPMTeaser" /> It was first identified in [[Star Wars: Episode I: The Visual Dictionary|''Star Wars: Episode I The Visual Dictionary'']], written by [[David West Reynolds (real person)|David West Reynolds]]<ref name="TPMVD" /> and published in [[May]] 1999.<ref name="Bite">{{CollectorCite|6|Books with Bite}}</ref>
